name: Coinbase x402 Bazaar
description: Searches Coinbase CDP's public x402 Bazaar catalog of pay-per-use APIs and calls them through a no-auth MCP server, REST API or SDK, for developers building agents that pay per call.

skills.name: Search Resources
skills.description: Searches the Bazaar catalog by intent and filters results by network, asset, payment scheme, merchant address and maximum USD price.

skills.name: Proxy Tool Call
skills.description: Calls a discovered x402 resource by tool name and arguments, returning a payment-required result when the service charges.

skills.name: Validate Endpoint
skills.description: Checks whether an x402 URL is reachable, returns 402 and advertises a valid discovery block, without making any payment.

skills.name: Browse and Merchant Lookup
skills.description: Lists every active resource in the catalog with pagination, or all the resources that route payment to one merchant address.
